::: {#def-credible-interval}
#### Credible interval

A $100(1-\siglevel)\%$ **credible interval** for a parameter $\param$,
given observed data $\vy$,
is an interval $\sb{l(\vy),\, r(\vy)}$
whose [posterior](#def-posterior) [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) is $1 - \siglevel$:

$$
\Prf{l(\vy) \le \param \le r(\vy) \mid \vY = \vy} = 1 - \siglevel.
$$

Source: @wikipedia_credible_interval.
:::
